title: 第五章 坑死个boss
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
任务重叠？没等林铮弄明白怎么回事，老村长开口说道：“我的眼镜你找了这么久也没找到，我估计是给那可恶的大贼鸦给捡取了！这样吧！你去击败大贼鸦，找回我的眼镜，最后的试炼就结束了！不过那大贼鸦很是狡猾，你可能会找不到，我这里有支百里香，你去玉米地找个地方点燃它，那大贼鸦就会出现了！大贼鸦不仅狡猾，而且很是凶猛，你应该智取为上，去吧！”
大贼鸦？一听就知道是个boss，也不知道是什么级数的。想找村长了解情况吧！嘿——！他还闭口不答了，让林铮很是郁闷！不过村长既然说了智取为上，估计是难以力敌了，看来得先做好准备才行。想了半天，林铮最后朝杂货店走了过去，买了捆绳子就朝玉米地前去了。
玉米地较深处有棵歪脖子树，这边也没什么玩家来了，林铮就把杀大贼鸦的地点选在这里。Ss评价勋章：经验获取+10%，在职业导师处学习技能费用减少80%，置于包裹中便可生效已绑定
好东西，这样一来被匕首吸收的经验就抵消了10%了，而且听杨琪说学习技能可要花不少钱，这倒是能给他省下不少。将勋章放回包裹，林铮开始算计将要出现的大贼鸦了。其实一只畜生有什么好算计的，给它做个套就是了！做好了套，林铮取出来一根香，就是村长口中的百里香了，
百里香：点燃后会散发诱惑大贼鸦的奇异香味将大贼鸦吸引而来任务道具
这简直就是为了坑那大贼鸦量身定做的！林铮点击使用，百里香马上就自动点燃了，然后林铮急忙将香插在预先设定好的地方，自己则马上钻到一边的玉米丛里。这百里香果然很是灵验，不到一分钟，随着一阵难听的呱叫声，一只巨大的三眼乌鸦飞了过来。看那个头，和神雕侠侣那只雕有的一拼，就现在玩家们的小胳膊小腿，还真是力敌不过啊！
大贼鸦：15级白银boss物理攻击389-560物理防御250法术防御250气血15000技能——风裂，掠影。大乌鸦的首领，贪婪的盗贼，对闪闪发光的东西十分狂热。
Nnd，瞧这属性，15000的血，还有250的防御，够林铮不停地打上好久的，这要是不下套，和它单挑绝对有死无生！怪不得村长强调要智取呢！眼看着大贼鸦一脚踩到了林铮设好的套，贪婪地嗅起百里香，林铮毫不迟疑的一下将手中的绳子拉起！只见大贼鸦的脚下的绳套瞬间收缩，没等大贼鸦反应过来就将它双脚困住，大贼鸦“呱——！”地一声惊叫就给吊到半空，这时林铮立刻冲了出来，手中绳子一甩，一下套住大贼鸦的脖子便朝歪脖子树一靠，最后绕着树转了好几圈，大贼鸦就这么华丽丽地给绑在树干上了，任它百般挣扎，就是无法动弹了！最后，在大贼鸦惊恐的眼神下，林铮不怀好意地笑着，拿着匕首慢慢地靠近大贼鸦。没有悬念的，大贼鸦被郁闷地在树上给活活捅死，然后不甘心地把它的大贼鸦绝对是首杀，爆了不少的东西。首先钱就不少，有20个金币呢！不过林铮最期待的还是大贼鸦爆出来的两件装备！第一件是一把剑，这件卖相倒是不错，剑长三尺三分，宽寸余，通体黑色，以一只狰狞的乌鸦为剑萼，尾部饰以蓝色宝石。
黑鸦剑：等级要求15白银器
物理攻击210-316，法术攻击190-223
力量：力量+20
撕裂1级：10%几率发动，5秒钟内持续掉血100点每秒
贪婪：最后一击杀死怪物有5%几率获得额外道具
附带特技：掠影
“真给那极品盼到了！”林铮摸着下巴想到，这把剑虽然比不上林铮的匕首，但在前期也是神器般的存在，这要拿去卖成rmb，可得值多少钱啊！不过要是让杨琪知道了那是会找他真人pk的。“嘿嘿！等下拿去吊她胃口！”想罢，林铮收起黑鸦剑，拿起了一个面具，这面具是一只狰狞凶猛的乌鸦造型，可以遮住上半张脸，倒是挺酷的，也很有装b的嫌疑！
黑鸦假面：等级要求15白银器

content_en:
Overlapping tasks? Before Lin Zheng could figure out what was going on, the old village chief said: "You haven't found my glasses after searching for so long. I guess they were picked up by that nasty big thief crow! Let's do this! You go and defeat the big thief crow, retrieve my glasses, and the final trial is over. But the big thief crow is very cunning. You may not be able to find it. I have a thyme here. If you go to the cornfield and light it, the big thief crow will appear! The big thief crow is not only cunning, but also very fierce. You should be smarter. Go ahead!
Big thief crow? As soon as I heard it, I knew it was a boss, and I didn’t know what level it was. I want to find out the situation from the village chief! Hey--! He still kept silent, which made Lin Zheng very depressed! But since the village chief said that outsmarting him is the best, he is probably outnumbered, so it seems he has to make preparations first. After thinking for a long time, Lin Zheng finally walked towards the grocery store, bought a bundle of rope and headed towards the cornfield.
There is a crooked-neck tree deep in the cornfield, and there are not many players here, so Lin Zheng chose this place to kill the big thief crow. Ss Evaluation Medal: +10% experience gain, 80% reduction in cost of learning skills from professional tutors, can take effect when placed in the package, bound
Good thing, this way the experience absorbed by the dagger will be offset by 10%, and Yang Qi said that learning skills costs a lot of money, so this can save him a lot. Putting the medal back into the package, Lin Zheng began to plan for the big thief Crow who was about to appear. In fact, if a beast has any tricks, just make a condom for it! After making the condom, Lin Zheng took out a stick of incense, which was the thyme mentioned by the village chief.
Thyme: When lit, it will emit a strange fragrance that attracts crows and attracts crows to come to the mission.
This is simply tailor-made to trick that big thief crow! Lin Zheng clicked to use it, and the thyme immediately ignited automatically. Then Lin Zheng hurriedly inserted the incense in the preset place, and he immediately got into the corn bushes on the side. This thyme was indeed very effective. In less than a minute, with an unpleasant croaking sound, a huge three-eyed crow flew over. Look at that head, it’s really incomparable to the players’ little arms and legs when compared to the Condor Heroes!
Big Thief Crow: Level 15 Silver Boss Physical Attack 389-560 Physical Defense 250 Spell Defense 250 HP 15000 Skills - Wind Crack, Glimpse. The leader of the crows, a greedy thief with a passion for shiny things.
Nnd, look at these attributes, 15,000 blood, and 250 defense, which is enough for Lin Zheng to keep fighting for a long time. If he doesn't trap it, he will definitely die in a duel with it! No wonder the village chief emphasized the need to outsmart him! Seeing the big thief crow stepping on the trap set by Lin Zheng and sniffing the thyme greedily, Lin Zheng pulled up the rope in his hand without hesitation! I saw the noose under the big thief crow's feet shrinking instantly, trapping its feet before the big thief crow could react. The big thief crow screamed "Cack!" and was hoisted into the air. At this time, Lin Zheng rushed out immediately, flicked the rope in his hand, wrapped the big thief crow's neck and leaned against the crooked neck tree. Finally, it circled the tree several times. The big thief crow was tied to the trunk of the tree so gorgeously, and it struggled in every possible way, but could not move! Finally, under the frightened eyes of the big thief, Lin Zheng smiled maliciously and slowly approached the big thief with a dagger. There was no suspense, the big thief crow was stabbed to death on the tree in a depressed manner, and then he was unwilling to kill the big thief crow, which was definitely the first one, and exploded a lot of things. First of all, there is a lot of money, there are 20 gold coins! But what Lin Zheng is most looking forward to is the two pieces of equipment that Big Thief Crow has released! The first item is a sword. This one looks pretty good. The sword is three feet and three inches long and more than an inch wide. It is completely black. It has a ferocious crow as the calyx and the tail is decorated with blue gems.
Black Crow Sword: Level requirement 15 silverware
Physical attack 210-316, spell attack 190-223
Strength: Strength +20
Tear level 1: 10% chance to activate, and continue to lose 100 blood points per second within 5 seconds.
Greed: Killing a monster with the last blow has a 5% chance of obtaining additional props
Additional stunt: Glimpse
"I've really been waiting for that top quality!" Lin Zheng touched his chin and thought, although this sword is not as good as Lin Zheng's dagger, it was still an artifact in the early stage. How much would it be worth if sold for RMB! But if Yang Qi knew about it, he would kill him in person. "Hehe! Let's whet her appetite later!" After thinking about it, Lin Zheng put away the Black Crow Sword and picked up a mask. This mask was in the shape of a ferocious crow, which could cover the upper half of his face. It was quite cool, but also looked like a pretense!
Black Crow Mask: Level 15 Silverware required
